name: Fifth Avenue Veterinary Hospital
notes: A Bay Ridge, Brooklyn veterinary hospital at 9102 5th Ave, (718) 748-1066. It is not open 24 hours (a reviewer rang on 2026-11-04): for an emergency outside these hours, go to a 24-hour hospital.
section: Emergency & poison control — BROOKLYN - 24 hour ER

change_log.note: Checked 2026-11-04. It has no working website (fifthavenueveterinaryhospital.com does not answer). The Mayor's Alliance lists "Open 24 hours, 9102 5th Avenue, Brooklyn, NY 11209, (718) 748-1066", which matches the record. Left at Medium: that is a reliable list, not the hospital's own page. A person should ring it to confirm.
A reviewer rang on 2026-11-04. Hours given: Mon, Tue, Fri 10-7; Wed-Thu 3-7; Sat 10-4. Not open 24 hours, as the research had said.
